validity.recommendation: existence and classification confirmed; see duplicate and spec concerns below
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: Real, well-documented, FERC-certificated interstate transmission pipeline. Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co LLC (TGP), a Kinder Morgan subsidiary, announced FID on this project 2024-12-19 (kindermorgan.com IR release), pre-filed with FERC beginning November 2024 (Docket PF25-2), filed its CP25-514 certificate application 2025-06-30, and FERC issued the certificate order authorizing the project 2026-07-31 (confirmed independently by pgjonline.com 2026-08 and the company's own project page). The Federal Permitting Improvement Steering Council announced 2026-09-08 that the project completed federal permitting (permitting.gov press release). Mississippi Free Press (2026-08-06, independent) corroborates with local reporting naming the FERC order and county-level route detail. This is a live, actively-progressing project, not a GEM-only/hallucinated entity. Classified transmission is correct for a large-diameter (36/42 in) interstate NGA-certificated mainline.

validity.researcher_notes: P7841 'Mississippi Crossing Project' and P7802 'Tennessee Gas Pipeline / Mississippi Crossing (MSX)' are the SAME physical project filed twice. Verified against the fresh 2026-09-10 GGIT snapshot: both rows carry Greenville MS -> Butler AL, LengthKnown 208.00 mi, Capacity 2100.00 MMcf/d, SegmentCost 1,700,000,000 USD, StartYear1 2028, Status proposed, Owner1 Kinder Morgan 100%. P7802 is the more complete row: it is structured correctly as a named segment ('Mississippi Crossing (MSX)') under the parent 'Tennessee Gas Pipeline' system entity, carries a gem.wiki page (https://www.gem.wiki/Tennessee_Gas_Pipeline, read for leads only, never cited), has the correct multi-value Diameter '36, 42' (P7841 is missing the 36in value -- see spec concern below), and has Operator populated ('Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co LLC'). P7841 appears to be a later, independently-created standalone row for the same FERC-filed project (no Wiki, ProposalYear 2024 populated where P7802's is blank, LastUpdated 2025-10-16 vs P7802's 2025-09-23) -- consistent with an EIA/FERC-docket-driven ingestion that was never matched against the existing P7802 segment. Recommend P7802 survive (parent-system segment structure, more complete Diameter/Operator, has Wiki) and P7841's ProposalYear (2024-11, sourced to KM's pre-filing start date) be carried over to P7802 during the merge since P7802's ProposalYear is currently blank. Note for the orchestrator: both P7841 and P7802 also carry separate route geojson files in the routes repo (../GOIT-GGIT-pipeline-routes/data/individual-routes/gas-pipelines/P7841.geojson and P7802.geojson) -- these likely need deduping too as part of any merge (not touched here; routes repo is out of scope without authorization).
